        About this item

        • SOOTHING NECK COMFORT FOR TECH NECK — Targets the back of your neck and upper cervical spine (C1-C7), where hours of screen time cause tension and stiffness. Nine precision-positioned massage heads deliver gentle vibration to the base of your skull, helping release built-up tension and restore natural posture. Vibration-based comfort massager — not a deep kneading device. Watch the demo video before buying. Note: Your satisfaction matters. Questions or concerns? Reach out via Amazon messages — we're here to help
        • TRIPLE-ACTION VIBRATION & WARMTH SYSTEM — Combines 7500 RPM vibration, dual-wavelength light (7×640nm red + 3×850nm near-infrared LEDs), and 4 heating pads covering 5,140mm². Red light promotes surface relaxation while near-infrared delivers soothing warmth deeper into muscle and fascia layers. Four precise heat levels (97–108°F) let you customize warmth from gentle comfort to an intensive warming session. 5 built-in massage modes with 4 intensity levels for personalized comfort — start at the lowest setting and increase gradually over 2–3 sessions as your muscles adapt
        • FSA/HSA ELIGIBLE | FOLDABLE & ULTRA-PORTABLE | 11 CUSTOMIZABLE MODES — Just 7.1×5.8×3.2 inches at only 6.6oz — slips into a backpack or handbag with no carrying case needed. Choose from 5 built-in device modes or unlock 6 additional techniques via the SKG Health App. Each function — heat, red light, vibration — toggles independently for personalized combinations. 2,400mAh battery delivers up to 140 minutes per charge. Built-in 20-minute auto shutoff prevents overuse — press power to restart
        • 9 TITANIUM-COATED MASSAGE HEADS — Crafted from 316L stainless steel with titanium nitride coating for durable, skin-friendly comfort and better heat conduction. A flexible bracket adapts to most neck sizes, while the bionic cyclone texture grips skin securely. Nine heads target key acupoints from neck base to upper shoulders. Fits 13.5–21 in (34–53 cm) — measure where your collar sits before ordering
        • PREMIUM GIFT THAT SHOWS YOU CARE — The luxurious titanium-gold finish with pearlescent leather texture makes a lasting impression for birthdays, Mother's / Father's Day, Christmas, Valentine's Day, anniversary or holidays. Perfect for office workers, parents, students, travelers, or anyone who deserves a moment of soothing relaxation. Includes premium gift-ready packaging, USB-C charging cable, and quick-start guide. Backed by SKG's 1-year warranty and 30-day hassle-free returns
        • NOTE: Our G7 Pro Fold neck massager combines infrared heat and gentle vibration with 9 heads to help relax tired neck muscles. For the most comfortable experience, lightly moisten the back of your neck before each session, ensure all heads sit firmly against your skin, start at the lowest setting and adjust gradually, and limit each session to 20 minutes. A mild sensation during use is normal — simply adjust the intensity to your comfort. Discontinue use if you feel any discomfort

        Important information

        Safety Information

        Wear the massager correctly and use a wet wipe to clean your neck area. Do not leave the device on continuously to prevent overheating or battery damage.

        Directions

        Wear the massager correctly and use a wet wipe to clean your neck area. Long press the center of the button for 1.5 seconds to turn on the device. Short press the center of thebutton to switch between modes. Push the joystick up to switch the vibration levels

          How customer reviews and ratings work

          Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

          To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

          About this Item

          • SOOTHING NECK COMFORT FOR TECH NECK — Targets the back of your neck and upper cervical spine (C1-C7), where hours of screen time cause tension and stiffness. Nine precision-positioned massage heads deliver gentle vibration to the base of your skull, helping release built-up tension and restore natural posture. Vibration-based comfort massager — not a deep kneading device. Watch the demo video before buying. Note: Your satisfaction matters. Questions or concerns? Reach out via Amazon messages — we're here to help
          • TRIPLE-ACTION VIBRATION & WARMTH SYSTEM — Combines 7500 RPM vibration, dual-wavelength light (7×640nm red + 3×850nm near-infrared LEDs), and 4 heating pads covering 5,140mm². Red light promotes surface relaxation while near-infrared delivers soothing warmth deeper into muscle and fascia layers. Four precise heat levels (97–108°F) let you customize warmth from gentle comfort to an intensive warming session. 5 built-in massage modes with 4 intensity levels for personalized comfort — start at the lowest setting and increase gradually over 2–3 sessions as your muscles adapt
          • FSA/HSA ELIGIBLE | FOLDABLE & ULTRA-PORTABLE | 11 CUSTOMIZABLE MODES — Just 7.1×5.8×3.2 inches at only 6.6oz — slips into a backpack or handbag with no carrying case needed. Choose from 5 built-in device modes or unlock 6 additional techniques via the SKG Health App. Each function — heat, red light, vibration — toggles independently for personalized combinations. 2,400mAh battery delivers up to 140 minutes per charge. Built-in 20-minute auto shutoff prevents overuse — press power to restart
          • 9 TITANIUM-COATED MASSAGE HEADS — Crafted from 316L stainless steel with titanium nitride coating for durable, skin-friendly comfort and better heat conduction. A flexible bracket adapts to most neck sizes, while the bionic cyclone texture grips skin securely. Nine heads target key acupoints from neck base to upper shoulders. Fits 13.5–21 in (34–53 cm) — measure where your collar sits before ordering
          • PREMIUM GIFT THAT SHOWS YOU CARE — The luxurious titanium-gold finish with pearlescent leather texture makes a lasting impression for birthdays, Mother's / Father's Day, Christmas, Valentine's Day, anniversary or holidays. Perfect for office workers, parents, students, travelers, or anyone who deserves a moment of soothing relaxation. Includes premium gift-ready packaging, USB-C charging cable, and quick-start guide. Backed by SKG's 1-year warranty and 30-day hassle-free returns
          • NOTE: Our G7 Pro Fold neck massager combines infrared heat and gentle vibration with 9 heads to help relax tired neck muscles. For the most comfortable experience, lightly moisten the back of your neck before each session, ensure all heads sit firmly against your skin, start at the lowest setting and adjust gradually, and limit each session to 20 minutes. A mild sensation during use is normal — simply adjust the intensity to your comfort. Discontinue use if you feel any discomfort

          Product Description

          Your Neck Deserves Daily Comfort — Every Day The average office worker spends over 8 hours a day hunched over screens, phones, and laptops. Over time, this "tech neck" posture places up to 60 pounds of force on your cervical spine, leading to chronic stiffness, tension, and the visible hump at the base of your neck. The SKG G7 Pro Fold was engineered to address this exact problem — with a triple-action system that combines soothing vibration, gentle warmth, and red light comfort. THREE TECHNOLOGIES, ONE SOOTHING SESSION At its core, the G7 Pro Fold combines three wellness-focused technologies: high-torque vibration (7,500 RPM) that delivers soothing massage comfort, dual-wavelength light — 640nm red light for surface relaxation and 850nm near-infrared for deeper soothing warmth — and four heating pads that maintain precise temperatures 36 / 38 / 40 / 42°C ± 2°C (97–108°F), creating a cocoon of comforting warmth around your cervical spine. PRECISION WHERE IT MATTERS MOST Nine massage heads, crafted from 316L stainless steel with a titanium nitride coating, are positioned to target the Tianzhu and Bailao acupoints — the exact spots where tech neck tension concentrates. The cyclone-textured surface ensures each massage motion transfers fully to your muscles without slipping, while the biocompatible titanium coating remains gentle even on sensitive skin. YOUR ROUTINE, YOUR WAY With 11 massage modes (5 on-device + 6 via the SKG Health App), 4 heat levels, and independent toggles for every function, you can build nearly 100 personalized combinations. Mode memory remembers your last setting, so every session starts exactly where you left off. Start at the lowest intensity and increase gradually — comfort is personal, and finding your ideal setting may take 2–3 sessions. DESIGNED FOR REAL LIFE Weighing just 6.6 ounces and folding to the size of a paperback book, the G7 Pro Fold travels with you — from your office chair to airplane seats to the couch at home. The 2,400mAh battery powers up to 140 minutes of use on a single USB-C charge. The built-in 20-minute auto shutoff protects against overuse — simply press the power button to restart. The premium titanium-gold finish with pearlescent protein leather isn't just beautiful — it's durable, stain-resistant, and easy to wipe clean. IMPORTANT: WHAT THIS MASSAGER IS (AND ISN'T) The G7 Pro Fold is a soothing vibration-based comfort massager designed for daily neck relaxation and wellness. It is NOT a deep kneading or deep tissue massager. The massage sensation may feel unique at first — different from traditional rolling or kneading massagers. We recommend starting at the lowest setting and gradually increasing over 2–3 sessions. Fits neck circumferences of 13.5–21 in (34–53 cm). If you feel any discomfort, reduce the intensity or stop use. This product is designed for daily comfort and relaxation, not medical treatment. FSA/HSA ELIGIBLE — Invest in your neck wellness using your pre-tax health savings. This product may qualify as a wellness expense under many FSA and HSA plans. We recommend checking with your plan administrator. TRUSTED BY MILLIONS WORLDWIDE SKG is a global leader in smart wearable wellness devices, recognized with Red Dot and iF Design Awards. Every G7 Pro Fold undergoes rigorous quality testing and carries all relevant safety certifications for the US market. IN THE BOX: G7 Pro Fold Neck Massager, USB-C Charging Cable, Quick Start Guide, Premium Gift Box

          Important Information

          Safety Information

          Wear the massager correctly and use a wet wipe to clean your neck area. Do not leave the device on continuously to prevent overheating or battery damage.

          Directions

          Wear the massager correctly and use a wet wipe to clean your neck area. Long press the center of the button for 1.5 seconds to turn on the device. Short press the center of thebutton to switch between modes. Push the joystick up to switch the vibration levels
